name: philmorehost/codevault
description: CodeVault — full WHMCS-parity billing platform, vanilla PHP

suggest.ext-gd: WebP image derivatives for static assets (core/Media/WebpImageService.php).
suggest.ext-imap: Mail piping — turns a real mailbox into support tickets (core/Support/ImapMailboxClient.php).
suggest.ext-redis: Sessions, queue and cache on Redis instead of the file/sync/in-memory fallbacks.

scripts-descriptions.audit: Report known vulnerabilities in the dependency tree.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Check coding style without changing files.
scripts-descriptions.schema: Fail if database/schema.php is out of date with the migrations.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the PHPUnit suite (needs MariaDB; see README).
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the suite with a coverage report.
scripts-descriptions.check: Everything CI runs: style, static analysis, schema snapshot, tests.
